title: Young and Free
description: A newly hatched octopus frees itself from its ruptured egg case at the Rosenstiel School of Marine and Atmospheric Science in Miami, Florida. Because octopuses lay their eggs over the course of a few months, the eggs hatch at different times. When hatched, a baby octopus is about the size of a pea. Octopuses are known for their intelligence and camouflaging capabilities.
translated_description: 在佛罗里达州迈阿密的罗森斯蒂尔海洋与大气科学学院，一只刚孵化的章鱼正从破裂的卵囊中挣脱出来。由于章鱼产卵过程持续数月，卵的孵化时间也各不相同。刚孵化时，小章鱼仅有豌豆大小。章鱼以其高智商和伪装能力而闻名。
